summary: HDFC Bank filed a 6-K furnishing an intimation of credit ratings, not a special situation. CARE Ratings reaffirmed CARE A1+ on the bank's certificate of deposit programme, enhancing the rated amount to INR 2,00,000 crore from INR 1,50,000 crore, on August 18, 2026. India Ratings assigned IND A1+ to a 7-365 day CD line of INR 500 billion and affirmed IND A1+ on a INR 1,500 billion line on August 19, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, pricing, or transaction mechanics are involved; this is routine short-term funding capacity disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
